items.title: AppLovin Soars 44% in Two Days on Q3 Beat: “The Transition Is Still in Front of Us”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAppLovin stock jumped 44% in two days after third-quarter revenue rose 55% and its fourth-quarter guide topped estimates. The slowdown this year’s selloff priced in hasn’t arrived, and the new ad models behind the beat are only partly rolled out.

items.summary: Key TakeawaysAppLovin’s third-quarter revenue rose 55% to $2. 18 billion, and CEO Adam Foroughi said the business can grow about 30% a year over the long term.
